mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, module_type AS moduleType, parent_id AS parentId, name, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt FROM doc_folder WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND module_type = #{moduleType} ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doc_folder (project_id, module_type, parent_id, name, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{moduleType}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt})
